title: Long Lattice Paths with No Three Collinear Vertices
summary: For $d\ge 1$, let $L(d)\in\mathbb N\cup\{\infty\}$ be the supremum of the lengths of paths in $\mathbb Z^d$ whose steps are standard basis vectors and whose vertex sets contain no collinear triple. We prove that \[ \log_2\log_2 L(d)\ge \frac{2}{5}d-O(1) \] for all sufficiently large $d$.
